role: CI guard (make skip-budget; ci.yml, gates.yml) that the number of XCTSkip/XCTSkipIf/XCTSkipUnless call sites in EmuquTests and EmuquUITests does not exceed .ci/test_skip_budget.txt.
toplevel: set -euo pipefail; no cd (relies on cwd = repo root). TEST_DIRS is assigned from "$@" (default one string 'EmuquTests EmuquUITests') and never used: the find is hard-coded to EmuquTests EmuquUITests, so CLI arguments have no effect. read_budget validates the file. Per .swift file, grep -cE counts lines matching `(^|[^/[:alnum:]_])(try +)?(throw +)?XCTSkip(Unless|If)?\(` (lines where the call is preceded by `/` such as `// XCTSkip(` are excluded, but `/* XCTSkip(` or a call inside a string are counted; two calls on one line count once). Prints count vs budget; if count > budget prints every matching line and exits 1. Appends a summary to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set. Passing below budget does not report slack.

flags.text: TEST_DIRS is built from the script arguments but never read; the scan always uses the hard-coded EmuquTests EmuquUITests, so passing directories silently does nothing.

units.does: Reads the budget file path $1: exits 66 if missing, strips all whitespace, exits 65 unless the result is all digits, prints the integer without newline.

branches.effect: stderr message, exit 66 (script terminates because called in $( ) under set -e)
stderr message, exit 65; otherwise prints the value
